newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 index slips back as activity dwindles.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 index slips back as activity dwindles.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index closed lower on Tuesday in much quieter trading on the Prague Stock Exchange.
The PX50 index edged 0.13 percent lower to 518.1 while the major issue dominated RPIX lost 0.27 percent to 1,067.4.
Major issues were mixed with Komercni Banka falling back eight crowns to 2,080 after rising strongly on Monday. Dealers said that a bout of profit taking had been anticipated by the market.
SPT Telecom, the most heavily capitalised share on the bourse, added to gains in the previous session with a four crown gain to 3,090.
Power utility CEZ lost five crowns to 980, while savings bank Ceska Sporitelna was unchanged on 316.

Among the less heavily capitalised issues, glass fibre maker Vertex dived 145 crowns to 3,000, conference orgainser BVV Brno fell 174 crowns to 3,325 and Severoceska Energetika rose 60 crowns to 2,630.
Turnover, at 693 million crowns, continued to fall from Friday's exceptionally high level.
